presets.title: Build a fantasy glade around an ancient giant tree

placeholders.name: landscape_material
placeholders.label: Landscape material
placeholders.hint: An existing landscape material whose layer blend names this recipe's paint layers, or none to make one that shows each layer in a flat colour.

presets.prompt:
Build a fantasy glade in {{level}}: a sunlit clearing round one ancient giant tree, old forest beyond, a path through. If a plan awaits approval, hyper_operation_wait with bWaitThroughApproval true.
1. hyper_model_inspect Folder {{content_folder}}/Glade; if mesh_modeling or pcg is off, say so and stop. hyper_model_apply_plan, dry run then bDryRun false (fresh OperationId): recipe ops (Shape, Size cm, Seed) tree 1200 (seeds 1, 2), tree 2600 (the giant, Accent #c9a640), bush 150 (seeds 1, 2), mushroom 60 (seeds 1, 2), grass_tuft 40; write_asset each to {{content_folder}}/Glade/SM_<Name>, trees Nanite=true, grass Collision=none. hyper_model_validate, Policy placeholder.
2. hyper_landscape_apply_plan (fresh OperationId): if {{landscape_material}} is none, first landscape.create_material Material {{content_folder}}/Glade/M_GladeLayers, PaintLayers Meadow, Forest, Path (flat colours); landscape.create Glade, Size 504, Noise Seed {{seed}} Amplitude 40, Material {{landscape_material}} or that one, PaintLayers Meadow, Forest, Path; landscape.road GladePath through (-24000,-8000,0), (0,0,0), (23000,9000,0), Width 3, Layer Path; landscape.paint Meadow, then Forest with Patch 120, Coverage 0.6; landscape.paint Meadow alone, Radius 45, Center (1,1,0) (a zero Center paints everything).
3. hyper_pcg_scatter_apply_plan (bSave true if World Partition): ecosystem.create {{content_folder}}/Glade/PCG_Glade, Forest on Forest (trees, bushes, mushrooms), Meadow on Meadow (grass), AvoidLayers Path, RoadMargin 2; volume.create GladeLife, Cover Glade. hyper_operation_wait for counts.
4. hyper_foliage_apply_plan: foliage_type.create for the giant; foliage.place it at (1500,-1500,20000), clear of the path, dropping onto the ground.
5. hyper_landscape_inspect for paint shares and HeightMax; hyper_verify_run, one case: AddPlayer at (6000,3000) at HeightMax in cm + 500, Wait Seconds 8, LookAt (0,0,0) and Capture, as PlayerIndex 1.
End with a PASS/FAIL table: three layers painted, model errors 0, every species above 0 and none on Path, giant placed. Show the capture on its own line; leave the level unsaved.

presets.title: Build a ruined courtyard with arches, walls and rubble

placeholders.name: stone_tint
placeholders.label: Stone colour
placeholders.hint: A hex colour painted into the models' vertex colour.

presets.prompt:
Build a ruined courtyard on {{selected_actor}} in {{level}}, centred at {{center}} (cm): a 30 m square of broken walls with an arch gateway, standing and fallen pillars, and rubble. If a plan awaits approval, hyper_operation_wait with bWaitThroughApproval true.
1. hyper_model_inspect Folder {{content_folder}}/Courtyard; if mesh_modeling or level_design is off, say so and stop. hyper_model_apply_plan, dry run then bDryRun false (fresh OperationId): recipe ops (Shape, Size cm, Seed) ruined_wall 800 (seeds 1-3), pillar 450 (seeds 1, 2), arch 500, rock 60 (seeds 1, 2), all Tint {{stone_tint}}; write_asset each to {{content_folder}}/Courtyard/SM_<Name>, Collision=convex, but hulls:4 for the arch so its opening stays open, hulls:6 for walls and none for rocks. hyper_model_validate, Policy placeholder.
2. hyper_spatial_query ground at {{center}}; hyper_landscape_apply_plan (fresh OperationId): landscape.sculpt flatten there, Radius 22, Falloff 12, Height that GroundZ in meters.
3. One hyper_spatial_apply_plan (fresh OperationId): place ops with bDropToGround true, Location Z 2000 cm above the pad: walls on the square's edges, the arch on the south edge, four pillars inside, two rolled 90 degrees; labels Court_<Part>_<n>.
4. hyper_foliage_apply_plan: foliage_type.create per rock mesh (Density 30, AlignToNormal true); foliage.scatter them in a 20 m circle at {{center}}, Clearings 3 m round the arch.
5. hyper_foliage_inspect for rubble counts; hyper_verify_run, one case (TimeoutSeconds 55): AddPlayer on the ground 2500 cm south of the arch, then as PlayerIndex 1 a Play step with Goal Reach, Target Court_Pillar_1, TimeoutSeconds 45, and Capture.
End with a PASS/FAIL table: pad slope under 3 degrees, model errors 0, every piece placed (Moves), rubble count, arch passable (Reach passed). Show the capture on its own line; leave the level unsaved.

presets.prompt:
Build a fishing village in {{level}}: a bay with beach and dunes, cliffs, a road with {{plots}} clear house plots, a headland lighthouse. If a plan awaits approval, hyper_operation_wait with bWaitThroughApproval true.
1. hyper_model_inspect Folder {{content_folder}}/Coast; if mesh_modeling or pcg is off, say so and stop. hyper_model_apply_plan, dry run then bDryRun false (fresh OperationId): recipe ops (Shape, Size cm, Seed) tower 2000 (lighthouse), rock 120 (seeds 1-3), bush 150, grass_tuft 50; write_asset each to {{content_folder}}/Coast/SM_<Name>, grass Collision=none. hyper_model_validate, Policy placeholder.
2. hyper_landscape_apply_plan (fresh OperationId): if {{landscape_material}} is none, first landscape.create_material Material {{content_folder}}/Coast/M_CoastLayers, PaintLayers Grass, Sand, Rock, Road, Plot (flat colours); landscape.create Coast, Size 1008, Noise Amplitude 30, Material {{landscape_material}} or that one, PaintLayers Grass, Sand, Rock, Road, Plot; landscape.sculpt lower (0,-30000,0), Radius 150, Amount 25 (the bay), and raise (25000,-25000,0), Radius 60, Amount 30 (the headland); landscape.road VillageRoad up from the beach, Width 5, Layer Road.
3. hyper_landscape_inspect for HeightMin/HeightMax. Second plan: landscape.paint Grass, Sand from HeightMin less 1 m to HeightMin plus 4 m, Rock from SlopeMin 35; per plot beside the road, landscape.paint Plot alone, Radius 12.
4. Find the ground at (25000,-25000) with Epic's SceneTools.trace_world from Z = HeightMax in cm + 1000 down to HeightMin in cm - 1000 (ground Z = that start Z less the distance it returns); place the lighthouse there (SceneTools.add_to_scene_from_asset at that Z, snap_to_ground), tag Landmark. hyper_pcg_scatter_apply_plan (bSave true if World Partition): ecosystem.create {{content_folder}}/Coast/PCG_Coast, Dunes on Sand (grass tufts), Slopes on Grass (bushes, rocks), AvoidLayers Road and Plot, RoadMargin 3, AvoidTags Landmark; volume.create CoastLife, Cover Coast. hyper_operation_wait.
5. hyper_verify_run, one case: AddPlayer at a plot at HeightMax in cm + 500, Wait Seconds 8, LookAt the bay and Capture, as PlayerIndex 1.
End with a PASS/FAIL table: paint shares, plots empty, counts per species, lighthouse grounded, model errors 0. Show the capture on its own line; leave the level unsaved.

2. hyper_model_inspect Folder {{content_folder}}/Highway; if mesh_modeling or pcg is off, say so and stop. hyper_model_apply_plan, dry run then bDryRun false (fresh OperationId): recipe ops (Shape, Size cm, Seed) ruined_wall 300 with Scale 1,2,0.67 (300 x 60 x 110 cm barriers, seeds 1, 2, Tint #9a9a94), rock 50, bush 150, grass_tuft 50; write_asset each to {{content_folder}}/Highway/SM_<Name>, barriers Collision=hulls:6, grass Collision=none. hyper_model_validate, Policy placeholder.
3. hyper_landscape_apply_plan (fresh OperationId): landscape.road Highway through {{road_points}}, Width 16, Falloff 10, Layer Asphalt; landscape.paint {{base_layer}}, then Verge with DistanceMax 14, plus any other layers it uses.
4. hyper_foliage_apply_plan: foliage_type.create per barrier mesh (AlignToNormal true); foliage.place 30 along the centre line, Z HeightMax in cm + 100, in broken runs.
5. hyper_pcg_scatter_apply_plan (bSave true if World Partition): ecosystem.create {{content_folder}}/Highway/PCG_Highway, Verge on Verge (bushes, grass Density 3), Cracks on Asphalt (grass Density 0.3, Patch 8; rocks), Country on {{base_layer}} (bushes, grass); volume.create HighwayLife, Cover the landscape. hyper_operation_wait.
6. hyper_verify_run, one case: AddPlayer at the road's middle point, HeightMax in cm + 500, Wait Seconds 8, LookAt its last point and Capture, as PlayerIndex 1.
End with a PASS/FAIL table: 30 barrier chunks placed, Asphalt growth sparser than the Verge's, counts per species above 0, model errors 0. Show the capture on its own line; leave the level unsaved.

presets.title: Prove a PCG generator, then dress an area with it
presets.summary: Read the selected PCG graph's recipes, prove it generates and cleans up on a small test volume, then grow it over a region and check what grew.
presets.prompt:
Check that the PCG graph {{selected_asset}} works in {{level}}, then use it to dress a {{region_size}} m square centred at {{region_center}} (cm).
1. hyper_pcg_scatter_inspect with Graph {{selected_asset}} and Detail summary: one recipe per mesh spawner, its meshes, cull distances and parameters. If the pcg tools are not available, say the pcg pack is off and stop. hyper_landscape_inspect: confirm a landscape lies under the region, and read HeightMax.
2. hyper_pcg_scatter_apply_plan (bDryRun false, fresh OperationId): volume.create GenTest at the region centre, Size 20 x 20 m, Graph {{selected_asset}}. hyper_operation_wait: instances per mesh.
3. hyper_pcg_inspect the graph and GenTest's PCG component for the revision and fingerprint. hyper_pcg_apply_plan with GraphPath, ComponentPath, ExpectedPersistedRevision and ExpectedComponentFingerprint from it, Intent Lifecycle generate_validate_cleanup and ExpectedTerminalState clean: a dry run first, then bDryRun false with a new OperationId and the ExpectedPlanHash; this proves the graph regenerates and leaves nothing behind. Then hyper_pcg_validate with Policy structural.
4. hyper_pcg_scatter_apply_plan (fresh OperationId): volume.create GenRegion at {{region_center}}, Size {{region_size}} x {{region_size}} m, Graph {{selected_asset}}; hyper_operation_wait for its counts.
5. hyper_verify_run, one case: AddPlayer at 3000 cm from {{region_center}}, HeightMax in cm + 500, Wait Seconds 8, LookAt {{region_center}} and Capture, as PlayerIndex 1.
End with a PASS/FAIL table: test counts above 0, lifecycle terminal state clean, validate errors 0, region counts per mesh, GenTest left at 0 instances. Show the capture on its own line. Leave the level unsaved.

presets.title: Make a dense forest scene fit its render budget
presets.summary: Cost-report a PCG forest, cut species density and cull distances in its ecosystem, regenerate, and prove the savings with the same report.
presets.prompt:
The forest that PCG volume {{volume}} grows in {{level}} is over budget. Bring it under {{draw_call_budget}} estimated draw calls and {{instance_budget}} PCG instances with the least visible change.
1. hyper_scene_cost_report with Scope level and TopN 20: EstimatedDrawCalls, EstimatedShadowDrawCalls, PCGInstances, ShadowCastingPrimitives, HeaviestMeshes and Findings. If it is not available, say the level_design pack lacks it and stop. hyper_spatial_query ground 3000 cm from the volume's centre; hyper_verify_run, one case (TimeoutSeconds 30): AddPlayer at that GroundZ, LookAt the centre and Capture, as PlayerIndex 1 (the before picture).
2. hyper_pcg_scatter_inspect with no Graph to find {{volume}}'s graph, then with that Graph: the Ecosystem op with each species' Density, Footprint and CullDistance. If the pcg tools are not available, say so and stop.
3. Plan the cuts, biggest saving first: ground cover Density down by up to half where it carries most instances and CullDistance 30 to 60 m; debris CullDistance 40 m; bushes 100 m; leave canopy trees alone. Density cuts lower the instance count; cull distances only lower what draws at runtime, which the report does not count. Show each change.
4. One hyper_pcg_scatter_apply_plan (fresh OperationId): ecosystem.set with the whole Ecosystem op as read, changed only as planned, then volume.generate {{volume}}. hyper_operation_wait for the new instances per mesh.
5. hyper_scene_cost_report again, and the same capture (the after picture).
End with a PASS/FAIL table: EstimatedDrawCalls and PCGInstances before and after against the budgets, shadow draws before and after, each species' change. Show both pictures on their own lines. Leave the level unsaved.

presets.title: Light a finished environment and take three hero shots
presets.summary: Set a warm low sun, sky, fog and locked exposure on a dressed scene, then capture an aerial, a mid and a ground shot and check their metrics.

placeholders.name: reference
placeholders.label: Reference image
placeholders.hint: An image path to compare the aerial shot with, or none.

presets.prompt:
Light the environment in {{level}} for a {{mood}} portfolio set, then take three hero shots. Change only lighting actors.
1. hyper_landscape_inspect for the landscape's extent and heights, and hyper_pcg_scatter_inspect for the PCG volumes, to frame the shots. If the lighting tools are not available, say the lighting_lookdev pack is off and stop.
2. hyper_lighting_inspect for the Revision, the sky setup and exposure.
3. One hyper_lighting_apply_plan with bDryRun false, a fresh OperationId and ExpectedRevision: set_sun pitch {{sun_pitch}}, yaw toward the main view, temperature 4500, intensity 8; set_sky_atmosphere mie_scale 1.3; set_sky_light intensity 1.1; set_fog density 0.02, height_falloff 0.2, volumetric_fog true; set_post_process saturation 1.1 and contrast 1.05; lock_exposure Value 3 (EV100). With a Blueprint sky, use set_sky_system for its time of day instead. If it awaits approval, hyper_operation_wait with bWaitThroughApproval true.
4. hyper_capture_view three times (Source transform, 1920 x 1080, bSettle true, Label hero-<n>): an aerial 300 m up at pitch -25 from a landscape corner; a mid shot 30 m up over a PCG volume at pitch -10; a ground shot 170 cm above the ground (find it with Epic's SceneTools.trace_world) along a road or path. If LuminanceP50 is outside 0.15-0.6, move lock_exposure 1 EV at a time and capture again.
5. If {{reference}} is an image, hyper_image_compare the aerial with it and report the score.
End with a PASS/FAIL table per shot: LuminanceP50 between 0.15 and 0.6, HighlightFraction under 0.02, bShadersStillCompiling false, exposure locked. Show the three shots on their own lines. Leave the level unsaved.
